headline: AJG Q2 Deep Dive: Organic Growth and M&A Integration Balance Pricing Headwinds
summary: Insurance brokerage firm Arthur J. Gallagher (NYSE:AJG) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 24.5% year on year to $4.00 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.84 per share was 0.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Arthur J. Gallagher (AJG) Appoints Ralph Nicoletti After Loss Of Lead Director
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher (NYSE:AJG) announced the passing of Lead Independent Director David Johnson. The board appointed Ralph Nicoletti as the new Lead Independent Director following Johnson's death. These board leadership changes affect a key governance role and board oversight structure. Arthur J. Gallagher, trading at $249.42, is in focus for investors following this change in board leadership.
